local_path: #   --local_input_source_map_tsv. Maps each collaborator-local input path (as it appears in the
#   UN-sanitized geneset.provenance.json / geneset.meta.json) to a public, resolvable source
#   identifier, so a third party can identify what data they would need to rerun the pipeline.
# Source identifiers are grounded in the actual Kids First portal manifests under
#   File ID = GF_*; Study Name column) and the GTEx v10 public downloads.
# NOTE: The 20260704 package already replaced these local paths with a placeholder, so this map

#   cluster outputs under .../KidsFirst_non_CBTN/outputs/analysis/). Verify the base prefix below
